findings.text: The restatement says “each row in the context,” but the theorem quantifies only over members of the supplied row and expression lists. Fix: State that evaluating each listed expression on each listed row with the supplied context gives `Fault.none`.

Moving `sessions` here leaves the task’s acceptance criteria pointing implementers to `PurgeFrameInstances.lean` for the pilot schema definition. Fix: Update the schema path in `plans/20261124-claim-proof-pilot.task.md`.

The status says every `sessionsSite` field uses a catalog rewrite and `decide +kernel`, but the data fields have direct values and `keyAlias` needs no rewrite. Fix: Say which fields use catalog equality and which are supplied or decided directly.

The status records three local pass results even though `AGENTS.md` and ADR 0020 D5 allow status files to cite only Nix check results. Fix: Keep the command names and remove their local pass outcomes.

The sentence stating `purge_frame_on_sessions` exceeds the 25-word limit and puts all three quantifiers before the guarantee. Fix: Introduce the parameter values, catalog condition, and complete environment in short sentences before stating which rows a successful run preserves.
The final sentence combines the concrete runs and three counterexamples in more than 60 words. Fix: Describe the concrete runs in one sentence and give each counterexample its own short sentence.
